main_upgrade.summary: Canonical dashboard dispatches now reach production, and LIVE proof is published as a snapshot-bound receipt without rewriting business evidence.
main_upgrade.why: The canonical publisher emitted a repository dispatch that Brain Management did not listen for, while deploy proof embedded in the canonical snapshot could self-invalidate by creating another unpublished snapshot. The receipt boundary closes both gaps and rejects stale, mismatched or incomplete proof.

portfolio.strongest_positive_change: Dashboard publication now has an event-driven, snapshot-bound proof path with deterministic rejection of stale receipts.
portfolio.largest_risk: Provider/live proof and observed business KPI sources remain the largest constraints across active commercial projects.

metric_impact.before: canonical dispatch had no production listener; LIVE proof could remain STALE after a successful exact deploy
metric_impact.after: repository dispatch triggers production and a matching immutable receipt can prove LIVE 4/4 without changing the snapshot timestamp
metric_impact.evidence: brain-management PR #41, production-workflow regression run 29522752138 and receipt validator tests

metric_impact.before: READY deploy metadata and old embedded proof could be mistaken for current LIVE evidence
metric_impact.after: LIVE requires exact snapshot/public timestamps, absolute deploy chronology, source SHA and all Portfolio/Project/Goal UI checks
metric_impact.evidence: publication-receipt.mjs plus five deterministic rejection/overlay cases

metric_impact.before: mirror equality could produce no push, leaving a manual heartbeat or workflow run necessary
metric_impact.after: canonical repository_dispatch is now an explicit production trigger even when mirror bytes are unchanged
metric_impact.evidence: paired ai-projects-brain dispatch and brain-management repository_dispatch listener
